doc_title: TRANSFER TO THE PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVE AS EXECUTOR/ADMINISTRATOR
doc_title_official: TRANSFER TO THE PERSONAL REPRESENATATIVE AS EXECUTOR/ADMINISTRATOR
when_used: The interest of a deceased proprietor is transmitted to the personal representative who holds it as executor or administrator of the estate.

detail_rows.label: as personal representative(s) of the Estate of
as personal representative(s) of the Estate of
Nature of Interest to be transferred

body_text.text: The Transferor(s) HEREBY TRANSFERS to the Transferee(s) the above-mentioned interest in the above Title.
The Transfer is subject to the following:
The provisions of The Land Registration Act (No 3 of 2012) and The Land Act(No 6 of 2012);
The interests noted in the Register of the Title.
The Transfer is also subject to the following additional provisions, (if any).
IN WITNESS the Transferor(s) have signed this Transfer as a deed.
